rules.description: Employee must be currently employed (from first day of employment)
rules.reason_if_failed: Carer's leave is only available to current employees

rules.description: Dependant must have a qualifying long-term care need
rules.reason_if_failed: Carer's leave requires the dependant to have a physical/mental illness expected to last >3 months, a disability, or care needs due to old age

rules.description: Employee has not exceeded their annual entitlement (1 week per 12 months)
rules.reason_if_failed: You have used your full entitlement of carer's leave this year. Your entitlement resets 12 months from your first request.

rules.description: For half day or 1 day requests, at least 3 days notice must be given
rules.reason_if_failed: At least 3 days notice is required for half day or single day requests

rules.description: For multiple day requests, notice must be at least twice the requested leave
rules.reason_if_failed: Notice period must be at least twice the requested leave duration

edge_cases.description: Employee needs immediate time off for emergency care situation
edge_cases.action: This may qualify for 'time off for dependants' (separate right) which doesn't require notice. Route to emergency leave guidance.

edge_cases.description: Employee has irregular working hours or pattern
edge_cases.action: Calculate entitlement: sum total hours worked in previous 12 months, divide by 52 (or weeks since start if <1 year). This is the leave entitlement in hours.

edge_cases.description: Employee is caring for more than one dependant
edge_cases.action: Clarify that 1 week entitlement applies to all dependants combined, not per dependant. Employee can use the week across multiple people.

edge_cases.description: Employer needs to delay due to serious disruption to business
edge_cases.action: Employer must propose alternative date within 1 month and provide written reason within 7 days. Cannot refuse, only delay.

edge_cases.description: Employee requesting leave in their first week of employment
edge_cases.action: Use expected weekly hours as the entitlement amount since no historical data available.
